strength_labels: descriptive tiers relative to this family's own 2025-26 races: strong = top third of calibrated strength, moderate = middle third, weak (no clear selection) = bottom third; insufficient information = top pick or more than half the field has no prior form
final_rating_kg: race-relative model score / score_per_kg_total (development-period within-race slope of score on the opposition-aware rating, so 1 kg of final rating = 1 kg of rating difference on average)
prospective_rule: fixed; evaluated on races from 2026-11-25; never refitted from individual results
